title: Copy-loop sites
statement: Let a copy-loop site be one of the following finitely many operations: choose the multiplier, either $P$ or $a$, according to a Boolean parameter, and copy it into counter $C$; copy $P$ into accumulator $T$, with a Boolean parameter; copy $P$ into radius $s$; copy $w$ into $C$ for the shift count used to form $K=2^w$; copy $w$ into level $I$; copy $w$ into $C$ for shifting the endpoint stack, with a Boolean parameter; copy $SE$ into $T$ for popping, with a Boolean parameter; copy $w$ into $C$ for the stack-halving count, with a Boolean parameter; copy the halved stack from $T$ into $Q$, with a Boolean parameter; or copy $w$ into $C$ for shifting $Q$, with a Boolean parameter.
hypotheses_covered: The copy-loop site is one of the listed constructors
Boolean parameters are available on the constructors that carry them
